name: Ziply Fiber
aka: Wholesail Networks,  A Ziply Fiber company
notes:
This ASN is about 60% FTTH, 20% DSL and 20% commercial fiber customers in addition to the other providers homed to 20055.

We only do 100G (or 400G) PNIs, if you don't require a 100G PNI we also peer openly at the IXes.

Note: we don't accept LOAs for peering ports, we issue LOA only for PNIs in third party facilities.
